'''Grazail''', or officially the '''Republic of Grazail''', is a country in [[Eastern Atirha]], in the [[Mii lands.]] Its [[25 municipalities]] have a total population of [[List of countries and dependencies by population|3,347,590]] [[List of countries and dependencies by population|making it the 122nd largest]] on Andah people in an area of [[List of countries and dependencies by area|202,209 km2 (78,073 sq mi)]]. It is bordered by [[Laselteh]] to the north, [[Etirha]] to the South, and the [[Rianan Ocean]] to the east. The capital and largest city is [[Mushira]], while [[Zayden]] is the Old colonial Estijan Capital and cultural center.

The area now known as Grazail was discovered in the mid 13th century; the area now known as Mii was inhabited principally by people known as Estijans. The [[Ama Koevw colony]] was established by [[Estijan]] in around 1390; the exact year is [[up to interpretation]]. From the late 14th century to the late 15th century, large parts of southern Grazail were ruled by a separate [[Estijan colony of Aravoria]]. The name Grazail was first used to refer to the colony in the early 15th century after the [[Grazail family]]. Grazail first gained independence from [[Estijan Huan]] in 1647 after the [[Laselteh independence war]], becoming a province of Laselteh in 1649. It secured its own independence after the [[Backstab war]] seceding from Laselteh. At first, Grazail was politically an oligarchy centered in [[Zayden]], [[Deah Falauai]] centralized control under herself in 1656, and [[crowned herself Queen]]. Grazil briefly became a [[republic in 1688]] following a [[revolution]], later becoming a [[monarchy again in 1690]] after the [[Grazail Civil War]]. Following the monarch's [[death in 1705]], the 2nd Republic of Grazail was proclaimed in 1706. 

Grazail has a [[wikipedia:Developing_country|lower-middle-income]] economy, mostly mineral- and [[wikipedia:Lumber|lumber]]-based, and is in the late stages of transition to a [[market economy]]. Grazail also performs well in the region in terms of the state's [[wikipedia:Sustainability|sustainability]] and [[wikipedia:Democracy#Development|democratic development]]. It is a member of the [[Democratic Action Council]], [[QOE]], the [[Global Trade Organization]], and the [[Organization for Security and Co-operation]].
